name: Ambato

queries.query: Ambato Ecuador official cadastral map parcel viewer catastro municipio Ambato
queries.result: First-party results identified the GAD Municipalidad de Ambato Dirección de Catastros y Avalúos, municipal Geoportal, and official ArcGIS cadastral layer SDE.AMBATO_PREDIAL. Indexed metadata describes a polygon layer in EPSG:32717.

queries.query: Ambato Ecuador catastro visor predial oficial municipio
queries.result: First-party results identified the same municipal Geoportal and Catastros y Avalúos department. The Geoportal states that it provides predial cadastral information for Ambato and rural parishes; no separate Spanish-language service was identified.

registryBasis: The GAD Municipalidad de Ambato is evidenced as local cadastral custodian: its official Catastros y Avalúos page describes administration and updating of urban and rural property cadastre and municipal GIS/cartography. Its official Geoportal advertises cadastral parcel information, and its ArcGIS service exposes the municipal polygon layer.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal department page assigns urban/rural cadastral administration, cartography, and municipal GIS responsibilities.
Official Geoportal states that users can access predial cadastral information for Ambato and rural parishes.

officialSources.publisher: GAD Municipalidad de Ambato ArcGIS service
officialSources.observation: Indexed first-party metadata identifies SDE.AMBATO_PREDIAL as esriGeometryPolygon, EPSG:32717 / WGS 84 UTM zone 17S, with JSON and GeoJSON formats and fields including OBJECTID and ID_CATASTR.

serviceMetadata.safeIdentityCandidate: ID_CATASTR, with OBJECTID as service OID fallback; neither retained because no feature response was obtained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official service metadata and local custodian are evidenced, but no anonymous parcel feature response was obtained. Research completion is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made to obtain a parcel hit.
